description:
Implement a PySpark DataFrame adapter for BenchBox, enabling TPC-H benchmark execution
using PySpark's DataFrame API. PySpark belongs to the Expression family (like Polars),
using lazy evaluation and expression-based column operations.

Current State:
- BenchBox has existing Spark SQL adapter (benchbox/platforms/spark.py) for SQL mode
- Expression family base class exists (ExpressionFamilyAdapter)
- Polars adapter serves as reference implementation for Expression family
- TPC-H queries have dual implementations (pandas_impl, expression_impl)

Value Proposition:
- Enables DataFrame vs SQL comparison for Spark platform
- Supports distributed execution (local + cluster modes)
- Bridges to existing Spark infrastructure users may have
- Completes the Expression family platform coverage
